claims.statement: For A in L_T, the homogeneous linear Darboux rays are exactly the n coordinate rays and one ray per edge (support that edge) if and only if Delta_T != 0; then there are exactly 2n-1 rays.
Complete Darboux set where exactly one factor of Delta_T vanishes: one edge ray lost, or one extra ray of support {u,v} or {u,j,v}.
The normalised tree family is exactly the space of homogeneous quadratic vector fields tangent to the graphic arrangement of Cone(T); dimension 2n-1.
The complete Darboux set of a generic tree system determines the tree up to isomorphism.

If a system in U_T is linearly conjugate to a system in L_T' (arbitrary parameters), then T and T' are isomorphic; hence van der Kamp's Conjecture 12 (generic parameters) holds, in this stronger one-sided form.

The all-parameter extension of the conjecture fails: L_T and L_(T-uj+uv) meet in a hyperplane; explicit matrix in L_P4 and L_K13. This does not affect Conjecture 12, which concerns generic parameters.
LV-preserving linear coordinate systems of a generic T-system correspond to spanning trees of Cone(T) (det(I+L_T) of them); supports are fundamental paths.
Isomorphic support hypergraphs are exactly orbits of Aut M(Cone T) = (C_2)^leaves x| Aut(T).
Orbit classification reduces to Aut(H, lambda)-orbits of decorated rooted forests of the internal-vertex tree H.
q(P_n) = (F_{2n-2} + F_{n-1})/2 (OEIS A051450 with shifted index; no bijection claimed).
Burnside formula for q(T) for every caterpillar.
A quadratic system is linearly conjugate to a U_T-system iff its linear Darboux rays are 2n-1 in number with matroid isomorphic to M(Cone T).
Every ray of D_T is a discrete Darboux polynomial of the Kahan map in every presentation.
Constant linear growth rate b: Darboux-set, presentation and counting results unchanged; tangent-field, recognition and Kahan statements modified as stated.
Within orthant-preserving linear changes, the original tree presentation is the only one.
All 94 trees with n<=9 (cone bases) and all 200 trees with n<=10 (core forests); multisets equal van der Kamp's Table 7 for n<=8.
Checks of every new statement for small n (data/extensions_verification.json).
Van der Kamp's 13-parameter system (34): at five sample points its 9 rays do not form a tree-cone matroid.
Multi-factor strata; general class equals presentations for all n; formulas beyond caterpillars; quasi-monomial equivalence; Kahan completeness.
